title: Seamless Region Fallback Controller with Graceful Traffic Drain and Model-variant Circuit Breakers
creator: Ana Vega
description:
Goal: Implement a region-fallback controller that coordinates warm-standby readiness, performs graceful traffic drain from a failing region, and automatically falls back to compatible model variants with circuit-breaker semantics.

Scope: controller + runtime hooks + health gate definitions + rollout strategy. Not in scope: UI console changes (follow-up ticket) and billing changes.

Design highlights:
- Health gates: define multi-tier readiness checks (node-level kube probe, model-process liveness, KV-cache primer, synthetic latency/quality probe) that must pass before a region accepts production traffic.
- Warm-standby orchestration: maintain minimal pool in standby regions with GPU memory reserved for pinned models; use a priming flow that pre-populates KV caches for common prefixes tied to customer routes.
- Graceful drain: on region degraded signal, run a prioritized drain where VIP/routing layer shifts new requests to fallback targets while in-flight requests continue until token-limit or timeout. Implement back-pressure so downstream dedicated pools are not overwhelmed.
- Tier routing and circuit breakers: if primary model variant is unavailable, automatically route to a semantically-compatible variant (smaller quantized or different architecture) only when QoS metrics for that variant are within configured thresholds; otherwise escalate to deny/queue policy. Circuit breaker opens on sustained error rate or latency breach and closes progressively with canary checks.
- Metrics and SLOs: controller exposes per-region gates and model-variant health metrics to Grafana dashboards plus alerting rules for SRE and on-call.

Non-functional constraints: must add no more than 1.5ms mean added latency on request path in steady-state; controller decisions must be auditable and reversible; all changes follow rollout canary and feature-flagging patterns.

References:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Multi-Region+Failover+Controller+Design
- Draft architecture doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3c-fallback-controller
- Related Linear tickets: ENG-50241, ENG-52412, ENG-53678
acceptance_criteria: Controller deploys in staging and can coordinate warm standby startup for 3 regions
Synthetic priming flow successfully fills KV cache for 95% of targeted prefixes within 60s
Graceful drain moves 90% of new traffic away from a simulated failing region within the configured drain window without exceeding downstream CPU/GPU thresholds
Model-variant fallback respects circuit-breaker thresholds and can be observed opening/closing in Grafana
End-to-end test harness (k8s + mock routing) with deterministic failure injection exists in repo and green in CI
